4. SPACEBORNE OBSERVATION: Clear sky condition (20% cloud); optical NDWI (-0.050) and SAR radar (-9.2 dB) corroborate surface water extent.
5. CROSS-DOMAIN SYNTHESIS: Multi-agent consensus weighted score evaluates to 0.321 with 90.2% sensor certainty. Conclusion: ELEVATED FLOOD WATCH: River South Goa River Drainage Basin is rising; drainage networks under pressure.
